_meta.description: Frozen hedge-word lexicon for the Hedge Index Tier-1 metric (A33). SHA-256 of this file becomes part of the metric's implementation_hash. DO NOT EDIT without updating the metric version and re-running bit-equality tests.
_meta.source: Linguistically-motivated hedging taxonomy (cf. Hyland 1998 academic hedging, Lakoff 1972 hedges). Reduced to a practically-falsifiable closed set for clause-ablation evaluation. Rhythm metrics explicitly NOT included (per CLAUDE.md 'Explicitly unaudited').
